paragraphs: Liberty Media Corporation ("Liberty", the "Company", "we", "us" and "our"), through its subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in the motorsport and live entertainment industries with events held worldwide and operations primarily headquartered in the United Kingdom ("U.K.") and Spain. Our most significant subsidiaries include Delta Topco Limited (the parent company of Formula 1) ("Delta Topco") and MotoGP.

Braves Holdings, LLC ("Braves Holdings") was a subsidiary of the Company until the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off (defined below) on July 18, 2023. Sirius XM Holdings Inc. ("Sirius XM Holdings") was a subsidiary of the Company until the Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off (defined below) on September 9, 2024. QuintEvents, LLC ("QuintEvents") was a subsidiary of the Company and Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. ("Live Nation") was an equity affiliate of the Company until the Liberty Live Split-Off (defined below) on December 15, 2025.

The Company previously had a tracking stock structure. A tracking stock is a type of common stock that the issuing company intends to reflect or "track" the economic performance of a particular business or "group," rather than the economic performance of the company as a whole. The Company completed the transactions disclosed below to separate certain collections of businesses, assets and liabilities into separate publicly traded companies.

On July 18, 2023, the Company completed the split-off (the "Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off") of its wholly owned subsidiary, Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. ("Atlanta Braves Holdings"). The Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off was accomplished by a redemption by the Company of each outstanding share of Liberty Braves common stock in exchange for one share of the corresponding series of Atlanta Braves Holdings common stock. Atlanta Braves Holdings was comprised of the businesses, assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Braves Group (the "Braves Group") immediately prior to the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off, except for the intergroup interests in the Braves Group attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group and the Formula One Group, which were settled and extinguished in connection with the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off.

Braves Holdings is not presented as a discontinued operation in the Company's consolidated financial statements as the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off did not represent a strategic shift that had a major effect on the Company's operations and financial results.

On August 3, 2023, the Company reclassified its then-outstanding shares of common stock into three new tracking stocks—Liberty SiriusXM common stock, Liberty Formula One common stock and Liberty Live common stock, and, in connection therewith, provided for the attribution of the businesses, assets and liabilities of the Company's then-remaining tracking stock groups among its newly created Liberty SiriusXM Group, Formula One Group and Liberty Live Group (the "Reclassification"). As a result of the Reclassification, each then-outstanding share of Liberty SiriusXM common stock was reclassified into one share of the corresponding series of new Liberty SiriusXM common stock and 0.2500 of a share of the corresponding series of Liberty Live common stock and each outstanding share of Liberty Formula One common stock was reclassified into one share of the corresponding series of new Liberty Formula One common stock and 0.0428 of a share of the corresponding series of Liberty Live common stock.

Each of the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off and the Reclassification were intended to be tax-free to stockholders of the Company, except with respect to the receipt of cash in lieu of fractional shares. In July 2024, the Internal Revenue Service (the "IRS") completed its review of the Reclassification and notified the Company that it agreed with the nontaxable characterization of the transaction. In September 2024, the IRS completed its review of the Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off and notified the Company that it agreed with the nontaxable characterization of the transaction. The Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off and the Reclassification are reflected in the Company's consolidated financial statements on a prospective basis.

On September 9, 2024, the Company completed the split-off (the "Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off") of its wholly owned subsidiary, Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Inc. ("Liberty Sirius XM Holdings"). The Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off was accomplished through the redemption by the Company of each outstanding share of Liberty SiriusXM common stock in exchange for 0.8375 of a share of Liberty Sirius XM Holdings common stock, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares. Liberty Sirius XM Holdings was comprised of the businesses, assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group immediately prior to the Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off. The Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off was intended to be tax-free to holders of Liberty SiriusXM common stock (except with respect to cash received in lieu of fractional shares).

Liberty Sirius XM Holdings is presented as a discontinued operation in the accompanying consolidated financial statements. Prior to the Reclassification, Liberty's interest in Live Nation, Liberty's 0.5% Exchangeable Senior Debentures due 2050 and a margin loan secured by shares of Live Nation were attributed to the Liberty SiriusXM Group.

On December 15, 2025, the Company completed the split-off (the "Liberty Live Split-Off") of its wholly owned subsidiary, Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. ("Liberty Live Holdings"). The Liberty Live Split-Off was accomplished by a redemption by the Company of each outstanding share of its Liberty Live common stock in exchange for one share of the corresponding series of common stock of Liberty Live Holdings. Liberty Live Holdings was comprised of the businesses, assets and liabilities attributed to the Liberty Live Group. Immediately prior to the Liberty Live Split-Off, QuintEvents, certain private assets and approximately $172 million of cash were reattributed from the Formula One Group to the Liberty Live Group in exchange for certain private assets. The Liberty Live Split-Off was intended to be tax-free to stockholders of the Company.

The Company's investment in Live Nation (including related debt and derivative instruments) and corporate cash and expenses previously attributed to the Liberty Live Group are presented as discontinued operations in the Company's consolidated financial statements.

Prior to the Liberty Live Split-Off, the Formula One Group was primarily comprised of Liberty's interests in Formula 1, MotoGP and QuintEvents, cash and Liberty's 2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027. As previously disclosed, QuintEvents, certain private assets and approximately $172 million of cash were reattributed from the Formula One Group to the Liberty Live Group in exchange for certain private assets immediately prior to the Liberty Live Split-Off. Following the Liberty Live Split-Off, the Company's only remaining outstanding common stock, the Liberty Formula One common stock, is no longer a tracking stock.
Our most significant subsidiaries are Formula 1 and MotoGP. Formula 1

Formula 1 holds the exclusive commercial rights with respect to the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile ("FIA") Formula One World Championship (the "F1 Championship"), an annual, approximately nine-month long, motor race-based competition in which teams (the "Formula 1 Teams") compete for the Constructors' Championship and drivers compete for the Drivers' Championship. The F1 Championship, which has been held every year since 1950 and takes place on high profile iconic circuits, is a global series with a varying number of events ("Formula 1 Events") taking place in different countries around the world each season. In 2025, 24 Formula 1 Events took place in 21 countries across Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and North and South America. In 2025, the F1 Championship was followed by hundreds of millions of television viewers in approximately 200 territories and the largest Formula 1 Events have hosted live audiences in excess of 450,000 on race weekends.

headings: Risks Relating to our Corporate History, Macroeconomic Conditions and Industry
Our businesses may not realize the benefits of acquisitions or other strategic investments and initiatives.
Weak and uncertain economic conditions may reduce consumer demand for products, services and events offered by our businesses.
Both of our operating subsidiaries have operations outside of the U.S. that are subject to numerous operational risks.
We may be subject to significant tax liabilities related to the Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off and the Liberty Live Split-Off.
Formula 1 and MotoGP have been, and may in the future be, materially impacted by a pandemic or epidemic, such as COVID-19.
Risks Relating to Our Businesses
Termination of the 100-Year Agreements could cause Formula 1 to discontinue its operations.
Termination of the FIM Agreement could cause MotoGP to discontinue its operations.
Formula 1 Teams may, in certain circumstances, terminate their existing commitment to participate in the F1 Championship or breach their obligations and withdraw.
Termination of the IRTA Agreements could cause MotoGP to discontinue its operations, and a reduction in the number of MotoGP Teams could reduce the appeal of the MotoGP Championship.
The FIA may take actions that are not in Formula 1's interest.
The FIM may take actions that are not in MotoGP's interest.
Formula 1 and MotoGP may be subject to enforcement actions under competition laws.
Formula 1 or MotoGP may be unable to renew, replace or renegotiate on favorable terms one or more of Formula 1's or MotoGP's respective race promotion, media rights or sponsorship contracts.
Formula 1 and MotoGP are exposed to credit-related losses in the event of non-performance by counterparties to Formula 1's and MotoGP's respective key commercial contracts.

Potential challenges by tax authorities in the jurisdictions in which Formula 1 and MotoGP operate could adversely affect Formula 1 and MotoGP's respective financial results and position and in turn, the Company.
Changes in tax laws could adversely affect Formula 1, MotoGP and the Company.
Formula 1 and MotoGP may face difficulties expanding into new markets, including as a result of being unable to attract race promoters for new Events.
Accidents during Events may cause losses that are not covered by insurance, disrupt an Event and cause Formula 1 and/or MotoGP reputational damage.
paragraphs: An investment in our common stock involves risk. Before investing in our common stock, in addition to the other information described in Item 7 ("Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations") of Part II, you should carefully consider the following risks. Such risks are not the only ones that relate to our businesses and capitalization. The risks described below are considered to be the most material. However, there may be other unknown or unpredictable economic, business, competitive, regulatory or other factors that also could have material adverse effects on our businesses. Past financial performance may not be a reliable indicator of future performance and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods. If any of the events described below or in the documents incorporated by reference herein were to occur, our businesses, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and/or cash flows could be materially adversely affected, which in turn could have a material adverse effect on the value of our common stock.

Our business strategy and that of our subsidiaries may include selective acquisitions, other strategic investments and initiatives that allow them to expand their business. The success of any acquisition, including the acquisition of MotoGP, depends upon effective integration and management of acquired businesses and assets into the acquirer's operations, which is subject to risks and uncertainties, including the realization of the growth potential, any anticipated synergies and cost savings, the ability to retain and attract personnel, the diversion of management's attention from other business concerns and undisclosed or potential legal liabilities of acquired businesses or assets.

The unaudited pro forma financial information of the Company and MotoGP included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K is presented for illustrative purposes only and does not purport to represent the actual results of operations of the Company or MotoGP had the acquisition of MotoGP occurred on January 1, 2024, or to project the results of operations of the Company for any future periods.

The unaudited pro forma financial information of the Company and MotoGP included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K is presented for illustrative purposes only and does not purport to represent the actual results of operations of the Company or MotoGP had the acquisition of MotoGP occurred on January 1, 2024, or to project the results of operations of the Company for any future periods. The pro forma financial information was prepared based on historical financial information of MotoGP assuming the acquisition of MotoGP took place on January 1, 2024 and includes certain adjustments based on preliminary allocations. Additionally, the pro forma adjustments are based on available information and certain assumptions that our management believes are reasonable. The pro forma adjustments are directly attributable to the acquisition and are expected to have a continuing impact on the results of operations of the Company. The pro forma information is not representative of the Company's future results of operations nor does it reflect what the Company's results of operations would have been if the acquisition of MotoGP had occurred previously and the Company consolidated MotoGP during the periods presented. In addition, future results may differ significantly from those reflected in such pro forma financial information, which does not give effect to the potential impact of current financial conditions, or any anticipated revenue enhancements, cost savings or operating synergies that may result from the acquisition of MotoGP. Further, the assumptions used in preparing the pro forma financial information may not prove to be accurate, and other factors, including those risks described below, may affect the Company's and MotoGP's financial condition or results of operations.

A weak or uncertain economy in the U.S. or globally could adversely affect demand for our products, services and events. Economic tensions and changes in international trade policies, including, for example, the widespread tariffs announced by the U.S. on its major trading partners, higher tariffs on imported goods and materials and actions taken in response (such as retaliatory tariffs or other trade protectionist measures or the renegotiation of free trade agreements), have increased inflationary cost pressures and recessionary fears. A substantial portion of our revenue is derived from

discretionary spending by individuals, which typically falls during times of economic recession or instability. A reduction in discretionary spending could adversely affect revenue through reduced live-entertainment and sporting event expenditures. Accordingly, the ability of our businesses to increase or maintain revenue and earnings could be adversely affected to the extent that relevant economic environments remain weak or decline further. In addition, inflationary pressures, which have been significant and remain significant, may increase operational costs, including labor costs, and elevated interest rates or any future increases in interest rates in response to concerns about inflation may have the effect of further increasing economic uncertainty and heightening these risks. We currently are unable to predict the extent of any of these potential adverse effects.

MotoGP is responsible for the commercial exploitation and development of the MotoGP Championship.

paragraphs: Liberty Media Corporation ("Liberty", the "Company", "we", "us" and "our"), 透過其子公司，主要從事 motorsport 與現場娛樂產業，舉辦全球性活動，營運主要總部設於英國 ("U.K.") 與西班牙。我們最重要的子公司包括 Delta Topco Limited (Formula 1 的母公司) ("Delta Topco") 與 MotoGP。

Braves Holdings, LLC ("Braves Holdings") 曾為本公司子公司，直至 2023 年 7 月 18 日的 Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off (定義於下文)。Sirius XM Holdings Inc. ("Sirius XM Holdings") 曾為本公司子公司，直至 2024 年 9 月 9 日的 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off (定義於下文)。QuintEvents, LLC ("QuintEvents") 曾為本公司子公司，Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. ("Live Nation") 曾為本公司權益聯盟，直至 2025 年 12 月 15 日的 Liberty Live Split-Off (定義於下文)。
本公司先前採用過追蹤股結構。追蹤股是一種普通股，發行公司意圖反映或 "追蹤" 某個業務或 "羣組" 的經濟表現，而非公司整體的經濟表現。本公司完成下列交易，以將某些業務羣組、資產與負債分為獨立的公開交易公司。

2023 年 7 月 18 日，本公司完成其全資子公司 Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. ("Atlanta Braves Holdings") 的分拆 ("Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off")。Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 透過本公司贖回所有 Liberty Braves 普通股，換取對應系列的 Atlanta Braves Holdings 普通股。Atlanta Braves Holdings 包含 Liberty Braves Group ("Braves Group") 在 Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 之前所屬的業務、資產與負債，除了屬於 Liberty SiriusXM Group 與 Formula One Group 的跨集團權益，這些權益在 Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 期間已結清並終止。
Braves Holdings 並未在本公司合併財務報表中列為已終止營運，因為 Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 並未代表對本公司營運與財務結果有重大影響的戰略轉變。

2023 年 8 月 3 日，本公司將當時發行的普通股重新分類為三種新追蹤股—Liberty SiriusXM 普通股、Liberty Formula One 普通股與 Liberty Live 普通股，並於此同時，將本公司當時剩餘追蹤股羣組的業務、資產與負債歸屬至新成立的 Liberty SiriusXM Group、Formula One Group 與 Liberty Live Group ("Reclassification")。Reclassification 之後，每支當時發行的 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股重新分類為一支對應系列的新 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股與 0.2500 支對應系列的 Liberty Live 普通股；每支當時發行的 Liberty Formula One 普通股重新分類為一支對應系列的新 Liberty Formula One 普通股與 0.0428 支對應系列的 Liberty Live 普通股。

Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 與 Reclassification 均旨在對本公司股東為稅務無影響，除了以現金代替 fractional shares 的情況。2024 年 7 月，美國國稅局 ("IRS") 完成對 Reclassification 的審查，並通知本公司同意該交易為稅務無影響。2024 年 9 月，IRS 完成對 Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 的審查，並通知本公司同意該交易為稅務無影響。Atlanta Braves Holdings Split-Off 與 Reclassification 會在本公司合併財務報表中以前瞻性方式反映。

2024 年 9 月 9 日，本公司完成其全資子公司 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Inc. ("Liberty Sirius XM Holdings") 的分拆 ("Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off")。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off 透過本公司贖回所有 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股，換取 0.8375 支 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 普通股，以現金代替 fractional shares。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 包含 Liberty SiriusXM Group 在 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off 之前所屬的業務、資產與負債。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off 原本旨在對 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股持有人為稅務無影響 (除了以現金代替 fractional shares 的情況)。
Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 被列為已終止營運，在隨附之合併財務報表中呈現。於重分類前，Liberty 對 Live Nation 的權益、Liberty 的 0.5% 可轉換高收益票據（到期日為 2050 年）以及以 Live Nation 股票為擔保的貸款，均歸屬於 Liberty SiriusXM 羣組。

於 2025 年 12 月 15 日，本公司完成其全資子公司 Liberty Live Holdings, Inc.（"Liberty Live Holdings"）的分拆（"Liberty Live 分拆"）。此 Liberty Live 分拆透過本公司贖回所有 outstanding 的 Liberty Live 普通股，並以一張對應系列的 Liberty Live Holdings 普通股交換。Liberty Live Holdings 包含歸屬於 Liberty Live 羣組的業務、資產與負債。於 Liberty Live 分拆前，QuintEvents、某些私人資產及約 1.72 億美元現金，從 Formula One 羣組重新歸屬於 Liberty Live 羣組，以交換某些私人資產。此 Liberty Live 分拆旨在對本公司股東而言為稅務無負擔。
本公司對 Live Nation 的投資（包括相關債務及衍生工具）以及先前歸屬於 Liberty Live 羣組的公司現金及費用，在本公司合併財務報表中被列為已終止營運。

於 Liberty Live 分拆前，Formula One 羣組主要由 Liberty 對 Formula 1、MotoGP 及 QuintEvents 的權益、現金及 Liberty 的 2.25% 可轉換高收益票據（到期日為 2027 年）組成。如先前所披露，QuintEvents、某些私人資產及約 1.72 億美元現金，於 Liberty Live 分拆前從 Formula One 羣組重新歸屬於 Liberty Live 羣組，以交換某些私人資產。於 Liberty Live 分拆後，本公司唯一尚未兌換的普通股，Liberty Formula One 普通股，已不再是追蹤股。
我們最重要的子公司為 Formula 1 與 MotoGP。Formula 1

Formula 1 擁有 Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile（"FIA"）Formula One 世界錦標賽（"F1錦標賽"）的獨家商業權利，這是一項每年舉辦、約九個月長的賽車競賽，各隊伍（"Formula 1 隊"）競逐車隊錦標賽，駕駛員則競逐車手錦標賽。F1錦標賽自 1950 年起每年舉辦，並在高知名度的經典賽道舉行，為一項全球性賽事，每季在不同國家舉辦不同數量的賽事（"Formula 1 賽事"）。2025 年，24 場 Formula 1 賽事在歐洲、亞太、中東及北南美洲共 21 個國家舉行。2025 年，F1錦標賽在約 200 個地區吸引數百萬電視觀眾觀看，最大型的 Formula 1 賽事在賽事週末的現場觀眾人數超過 45 萬人。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析提供有關我們營運成果與財務狀況之資訊。此討論應與我們附屬之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。請參閱附屬合併財務報表之附註 4，以瞭解我們已採用或預計採用之會計準則，這些準則已或可能對我們財務報表產生影響。
Liberty 透過其子公司，主要從事賽車運動與現場娛樂產業。

Formula 1 是 wholly-owned subsidiary 並為應報告分部。Formula 1 是一間全球賽車運動公司，擁有對國際汽車聯盟（"FIA"）一級方程式世界錦標賽（"F1錦標賽"）的獨家商業權利，這是一項每年約九個月長的賽車競賽，車隊競逐車隊錦標賽，駕駛員競逐車手錦標賽。F1錦標賽在多種賽道舉行，每季在世界各地不同國家舉辦不同數量的賽事（"一級方程式賽事"）。Formula 1 負責 F1錦標賽的商業開發與發展，以及其各項管理與行政事務。

於 2025 年 7 月 3 日，本公司取得 MotoGP Sports Entertainment Group, S.L.（原為 Dorna Sports, S.L.）（"MotoGP"）約 84% 的股權，初步購價約為 36.59 億美元（約 31.22 億歐元）。MotoGP 是一間應報告分部，為一間全球賽車運動公司，擁有對國際摩托車聯盟（"FIM"）大獎賽世界錦標賽（"MotoGP錦標賽"）的獨家商業權利，這是一項每年約九個月長的摩托車競賽，騎士競逐騎士錦標賽，車隊（"MotoGP 車隊"）競逐車隊錦、引擎製造商競逐製造商錦標賽。MotoGP 負責 MotoGP 錦標賽的商業開發與發展。

我們的 "企業及其它" 分部包括企業費用與投資及其它公司的相關金融工具。QuintEvents, LLC（"QuintEvents"）曾為本公司的合併子公司，並納入 "企業及其它" 分部，直至 Liberty Live 分離（定義如下）。Braves Holdings, LLC（"Braves Holdings"）曾為本公司的合併子公司，並納入 "企業及其它" 分部，直至 Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離（定義如下）。
本公司先前採用過追蹤股票結構。追蹤股票是一種普通股，發行公司意圖反映或 "追蹤" 某特定業務或 "羣組" 的經濟表現，而非公司整體的經濟表現。本公司完成下列交易，以將某些業務、資產與負債分離為獨立上市的公司。

於 2023 年 7 月 18 日，本公司完成其 wholly owned subsidiary，Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.（"Atlanta Braves Holdings"）的分離（"Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離"）。Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離係透過本公司贖回所有 outstanding 的 Liberty Braves 普通股，換取對應系列的 Atlanta Braves Holdings 普通股。Atlanta Braves Holdings 包含於 Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離前，歸屬於 Liberty Braves Group（"Braves Group"）的業務、資產與負債，除外屬於 Liberty SiriusXM Group 與 Liberty Formula One Group（"Formula One Group"）的 intergroup 興趣，這些在 Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離時已結清並終止。

於 2023 年 8 月 3 日，本公司將當時 outstanding 的普通股重新歸類為三種新的追蹤股票—Liberty SiriusXM 普通股、Liberty Formula One 普通股與 Liberty Live 普通股，並於此同時，將本公司當時剩餘追蹤股票羣組的業務、資產與負債歸屬至新成立的 Liberty SiriusXM Group、Formula One Group 與 Liberty Live Group（"重新歸類"）。重新歸類後，每支當時 outstanding 的 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股重新歸類為一隻對應系列的新 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股與 0.2500 的股份
本公司於對應系列之 Liberty Live 普通股及每張現有 Liberty Formula One 普通股，已重新歸類為一張對應系列之新 Liberty Formula One 普通股及 0.0428 張對應系列之 Liberty Live 普通股。

Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離及重新歸類均旨在對本公司股東為稅務無負擔，除非涉及以現金代替 fractional shares。2024 年 7 月，美國國稅局（Internal Revenue Service，簡稱 IRS）完成對重新歸類之審查，並通知本公司同意該交易為稅務無負擔。2024 年 9 月，IRS 完成對 Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離之審查，並通知本公司同意該交易為稅務無負擔。Atlanta Braves Holdings 分離及重新歸類於本公司合併財務報表中以前瞻性方式列示。

2024 年 9 月 9 日，本公司完成其全資子公司 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Inc.（簡稱 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings）之分離（簡稱 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 分離）。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 分離透過本公司贖回每張現有 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股，換取 0.8375 張 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 普通股，並以現金代替 fractional shares。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 為 Liberty SiriusXM 羣組於 Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 分離前所屬之業務、資產與負債。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 分離旨在對 Liberty SiriusXM 普通股持有人為稅務無負擔（除非涉及現金代替 fractional shares）。於重新歸類前，Liberty 於 Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.（簡稱 Live Nation）之權益、Liberty 0.5% 可轉換優先無擔保債券（2050 年到期）及以 Live Nation 股票為擔保之信貸，歸屬於 Liberty SiriusXM 羣組。Liberty Sirius XM Holdings 於隨後之合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。

2025 年 12 月 15 日，本公司完成其全資子公司 Liberty Live Holdings, Inc.（簡稱 Liberty Live Holdings）之分離（簡稱 Liberty Live 分離）。Liberty Live 分離透過本公司贖回每張現有 Liberty Live 普通股，換取一張對應系列之 Liberty Live Holdings 普通股。Liberty Live Holdings 為 Liberty Live 羣組所屬之業務、資產與負債。於 Liberty Live 分離前，QuintEvents、部分私人資產及約 172 億美元現金已從 Formula One 羣組重新歸屬至 Liberty Live 羣組，以換取部分其他私人資產。Liberty Live 分離旨在對本公司股東為稅務無負擔。
Live Nation 為本公司之權益法投資對象，直至 Liberty Live 分離。本公司對 Live Nation 之投資（包括相關債務與衍生工具）及原先歸屬於 Liberty Live 羣組之公司現金與費用，於本公司合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。

於 Liberty Live 分離前，Formula One 羣組主要由 Liberty 於 Formula 1、MotoGP 及 QuintEvents 之權益、現金及 Liberty 2.25% 可轉換優先無擔保債券（2027 年到期）（如附註 8 所述）組成。如前所述，QuintEvents、部分私人資產及約 172 億美元現金已從 Formula One 羣組重新歸屬至 Liberty Live 羣組，以換取部分其他私人資產，於 Liberty Live 分離前完成。Liberty Live 分離後，本公司唯一現存之普通股 Liberty Formula One 普通股，已不再為追蹤股。

headings: 與本公司歷史、總體經濟狀況及產業相關之風險
本公司之業務可能無法實現收購或其他戰略投資及計畫之效益。
弱勢且不確定之經濟狀況可能降低消費者對本公司業務所提供產品、服務及活動之需求。
本公司兩家營運子公司均有於美國境外之營運，且面臨眾多營運風險。
本公司可能因Liberty Sirius XM Holdings Split-Off及Liberty Live Split-Off而面臨重大稅務負擔。
Formula 1及MotoGP過去曾且未來可能因疫情或大流行（例如COVID-19）而受到重大影響。
與本公司業務相關之風險
100年合約終止可能導致Formula 1停止營運。
FIM 合約終止可能導致 MotoGP 停止其營運。
Formula 1 競隊在特定情況下，可能終止其現有參與 F1 爭冠的承諾，或違約其義務而退出。
IRT A 合約終止可能導致 MotoGP 停止其營運，且 MotoGP 競隊數量減少可能降低 MotoGP 爭冠的吸引力。
FIA 可能採取對 Formula 1 不利的行動。
FIM 可能採取對 MotoGP 不利的行動。
Formula 1 與 MotoGP 可能因競爭法而受到執行行動的影響。
Formula 1 或 MotoGP 可能無法續約、取代或以有利條件重新協議其 respective 賽事推廣、媒體權或贊助合約。
Formula 1 與 MotoGP 面臨因交易對手未能履行其 respective 重要商業合約而產生的信用相關損失。
稅務機關在Formula 1及MotoGP營運之司法管轄區對其進行之潛在挑戰，可能不利於Formula 1及MotoGP之財務結果與財務狀況，進而影響本公司。
稅法之變更可能對Formula 1、MotoGP及本公司造成不利影響。
Formula 1及MotoGP可能面臨在新市場擴張之困難，包括因無法吸引新賽事之賽事 promoters 而導致之問題。
賽事期間之事故可能導致未被保險覆蓋之損失，幹擾賽事進行，並對Formula 1及/或MotoGP造成聲譽損害。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及風險。在投資本公司普通股之前，除了第二部分第7項（"管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析"）所描述的其他資訊外，您應謹慎考慮下列風險。這些風險並非與本公司業務及資本結構相關的唯一風險。下列所描述的風險被認為是最為重要的。然而，可能還有其他未知或無法預測的經濟、業務、競爭、法規或其他因素，也可能對本公司業務產生重大不利影響。過去的財務表現可能無法作為未來表現的可靠指標，歷史趨勢也不應用來預測未來期間的結果或趨勢。如果發生下列或本文件所引用文件中所描述的任何事件，將可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況、營運結果及/或現金流產生重大不利影響，進而可能對本公司普通股的價值產生重大不利影響。
本公司及其子公司之業務策略可能包括選擇性併購、其他戰略投資及行動，以擴展其業務。任何併購（包括 MotoGP 之併購）的成功，取決於將取得之業務及資產有效整合至買方之營運，此過程面臨風險與不確定性，包括實現成長潛力、預期之協同效益及成本節省、保留及吸引人才的能力、管理層注意力被分散至其他業務事務，以及取得之業務或資產之未揭露或潛在法律責任。
本年度報告表 Form 10-K 所包含之本公司與 MotoGP 之未審計合併財務資訊，僅供說明之用，並不表示若 MotoGP 併購於 2024 年 1 月 1 日發生，本公司或 MotoGP 之實際營運結果，也不預測本公司未來任何期間之營運結果。

本公司與 MotoGP 未經審計之合併財務資訊，包含於本年度 10-K 報告中，僅供說明用途，並不表示若 MotoGP 併購於 2024 年 1 月 1 日發生，本公司或 MotoGP 之實際營運結果，亦不預測本公司未來任何期間之營運結果。此合併財務資訊係基於 MotoGP 之歷史財務資訊，假設 MotoGP 併購於 2024 年 1 月 1 日發生，並包含某些基於初步分配之調整。此外，此合併調整係基於可用資訊及本公司管理層認為合理之假設。此合併調整係直接歸因於併購，並預期對本公司營運結果有持續影響。此合併資訊並不代表本公司未來營運結果，亦不反映若 MotoGP 併購發生於過去且本公司於所列期間內合併 MotoGP 之營運結果。此外，未來結果可能與此合併財務資訊所反映者有顯著差異，此資訊未考量目前財務狀況之潛在影響，或任何預期因 MotoGP 併購而產生之收入增強、成本節省或營運協同效益。進一步而言，用以準備此合併財務資訊之假設可能無法準確，且其他因素，包括下文所述之風險，可能影響本公司與 MotoGP 之財務狀況或營運結果。

美國或全球總體經濟若出現疲弱或不確定性，可能不利於我們產品、服務及活動之需求。經濟緊張與國際貿易政策之變動，包括例如美國對主要貿易夥伴廣泛課徵關稅、進口商品與材料之關稅提高及相關措施（如報復性關稅或其他貿易保護主義措施或重新談判自由貿易協議），已增加通貨膨脹成本壓力與經濟衰退之擔憂。我們收入之相當大一部分來自於個人之選擇性開支，此類開支通常在經濟衰退或不穩定時期減少。選擇性開支之減少可能透過減少現場娛樂與體育活動支出，不利於收入。因此，我們業務之營收與獲利之增加或維持能力，可能因相關總體經濟環境持續疲弱或進一步衰退而受到不利影響。此外，通貨膨脹壓力已顯著且持續存在，可能提高營運成本，包括人工成本，以及高利率或任何未來因對通貨膨脹之擔憂而提高利率，可能進一步增加經濟不確定性並加劇這些風險。目前我們無法預測這些潛在不利影響之範圍。
